# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.
- `checkOpenPR` — when `true`, skip tickets that already have an open pull request for this work.
- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push
 * back to main is best-effort (a rejected direct push only warns). The
 * ledger never landed, so EIGHT consecutive releases (20261008-095538 →
 * 20261009-091304) all advertised sm_github: 0.1.36 while the content
 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip
 * (sha256 20352463… vs 0dc62ca4… from 075526) and version-keyed consumer
 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest
 *      metadata (version, sourceCommit) changes on every rebuild and must
 *      not force a bump by itself.
 *
 * Uses: loadModule(), suite(), test(), assert
 */

}

# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.
- `checkOpenPR` — when `true`, skip tickets that already have an open pull request for this work.
- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push

 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip

 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest
 *      metadata (version, sourceCommit) changes on every rebuild and must
 *      not force a bump by itself.

 */

# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.
- `checkOpenPR` — when `true`, skip tickets that already have an open pull request for this work.
- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push
 * back to main is best-effort (a rejected direct push only warns). The
 * ledger never landed, so EIGHT consecutive releases (20261008-095538 →
 * 20261009-091304) all advertised sm_github: 0.1.36 while the content
 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip
 * (sha256 20352463… vs 0dc62ca4… from 075526) and version-keyed consumer
 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest
 *      metadata (version, sourceCommit) changes on every rebuild and must
 *      not force a bump by itself.
 *
 * Uses: loadModule(), suite(), test(), assert
 */

'use strict';

/* global loadModule, assert, test, suite */

function guard() {
    return loadModule('ci/pack_version_guard.cjs');
}

# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.
- `checkOpenPR` — when `true`, skip tickets that already have an open pull request for this work.
- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push
 * back to main is best-effort (a rejected direct push only warns). The
 * ledger never landed, so EIGHT consecutive releases (20261008-095538 →
 * 20261009-091304) all advertised sm_github: 0.1.36 while the content
 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip
 * (sha256 20352463… vs 0dc62ca4… from 075526) and version-keyed consumer
 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest
 *      metadata (version, sourceCommit) changes on every rebuild and must
 *      not force a bump by itself.
 *
 * Uses: loadModule(), suite(), test(), assert
 */

function guard() {

}

# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.
- `checkOpenPR` — when `true`, skip tickets that already have an open pull request for this work.
- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push

 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip

 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest

 *      not force a bump by itself.

# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.
- `checkOpenPR` — when `true`, skip tickets that already have an open pull request for this work.
- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push
 * back to main is best-effort (a rejected direct push only warns). The
 * ledger never landed, so EIGHT consecutive releases (20261008-095538 →
 * 20261009-091304) all advertised sm_github: 0.1.36 while the content
 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip
 * (sha256 20352463… vs 0dc62ca4… from 075526) and version-keyed consumer
 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest
 *      metadata (version, sourceCommit) changes on every rebuild and must
 *      not force a bump by itself.
 *
 * Uses: loadModule(), suite(), test(), assert
 */

/* global loadModule, assert, test, suite */

function guard() {
    return loadModule('ci/pack_version_guard.cjs');
}

arguments.content:
### What changed
A dev leg whose whole provider chain failed with transient errors (`Provider chain exhausted` + only 5xx/429/network attempts) now classifies as `provider_transient` and resumes the persisted fa session ONCE after a configurable backoff, instead of discarding all work on a cold reset; if the resume also fails, the existing reset runs and the comment names the failing models and codes instead of guessing "rate limit".

### Key decisions
- `quotaCircuitBreaker.classifyFailure` gains the `provider_transient` kind (plus `extractOutageModels`/`extractOutageCodes`/`outageResetHeaderOf`); quota evidence keeps priority — a 403/quota chain still parks (I1), and 401/auth text never classifies as an outage (a resume can't fix credentials, I3 fatal path untouched).
- Outage resume lives in `feedbackLoop.resumeOnceForProviderOutage`: backoff via `bash -c "sleep N"` (`customParams.providerTransientBackoffSec`, default 90s — no new whitelist entry), then the existing bounded wrapper re-invokes `run-agent.sh` (fa resume-or-creates the deterministic `--session`). It bypasses the generic `feedbackLoop.enabled` flag but honors an explicit `missingResponse.enabled: false`; the shared `missing_response` attempt marker enforces at-most-once per leg (I2).
- `recoverMissingResponse` runs the outage branch after the quota gate and the fatal-environment check; on failure it falls back to the verbatim gh-742 reset (run stays RED), and `interruptedNoChangesComment`/`interruptedPartialWorkComment` (story) and `buildInterruptedComment` (bug) print `⏸️ Provider outage (<models>, <codes>) — reset for retry`.
- Bug leg shares the recovery and the honest comment via the same helpers.

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json        # 4910 passed, 0 failed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_quotaCircuitBreaker.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_feedbackLoop.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json
```
UT-1/REG-1 pin the run-39315836954 fixture (`zai/glm-5.3-flash` 500 ×3 + `kimi-for-coding` 429 ×12 → `provider_transient`) and the quota priority; UT-2..UT-5 drive the leg end-to-end with mocked `feedbackLoop`/CLI: forced single resume when disabled, landed `response.md` → normal PR path, failed resume → honest reset comment, `sleep 7` honored before the wrapper.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    ERR[CLI exits 1 — Provider chain exhausted] --> CLS[quotaBreaker.classifyFailure]
    CLS -->|403/quota text| PARK[quota park — gh-1087, I1]
    CLS -->|only 5xx/429/network| OUT[provider_transient]
    CLS -->|401/auth text| RESET[classic gh-742 reset]
    OUT --> BO[backoff bash -c sleep providerTransientBackoffSec default 90]
    BO --> RES[ONE bounded resume — run-agent.sh, fa --session restored, marker missing_response]
    RES -->|lands response.md| PR[normal PR path — run green]
    RES -->|fails / opted out| HR[reset + comment ⏸️ Provider outage models, codes — reset for retry]
```

</details>

# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.

- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push
 * back to main is best-effort (a rejected direct push only warns). The
 * ledger never landed, so EIGHT consecutive releases (20261008-095538 →
 * 20261009-091304) all advertised sm_github: 0.1.36 while the content
 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip
 * (sha256 20352463… vs 0dc62ca4… from 075526) and version-keyed consumer
 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest
 *      metadata (version, sourceCommit) changes on every rebuild and must
 *      not force a bump by itself.
 *
 * Uses: loadModule(), suite(), test(), assert
 */

'use strict';

/* global loadModule, assert, test, suite */

function guard() {
    return loadModule('ci/pack_version_guard.cjs');
}

{"path":"outputs/response.md","content":"### What changed
A dev leg whose whole provider chain failed with transient errors (`Provider chain exhausted` + only 5xx/429/network attempts) now classifies as `provider_transient` and resumes the persisted fa session ONCE after a configurable backoff, instead of discarding all work on a cold reset; if the resume also fails, the existing reset runs and the comment names the failing models and codes instead of guessing "rate limit".

### Key decisions

# story development

Implements a story end to end: checks out the repository, writes the code and tests, and opens a pull request linked to the story.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js` (project values win).

- `autoStartReview` — when `true`, automatically trigger the PR review workflow after this agent finishes.
- `autoStartReviewConfigFile` — agent config file used for the auto-started review workflow.
- `branchCreateFnPath` — path to a JS hook that creates the feature branch (two-branch flow customization).
- `cacheToReleases` — when enabled, caches the workspace into a git release so later runs restore instead of re-cloning.
- `autoSaveCommitMessage` — optional template for the periodic WIP auto-save commit made by the timer (default `{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`; also `formats.commitMessage.autoSave` in the project config). Use it when the target repo's commit-msg hook requires a tracker key, e.g. `AB#{ticketKey} WIP auto-save {timestamp}`.
- `checkOpenPR` — when `true`, skip tickets that already have an open pull request for this work.
- `customStatuses` — status name overrides for this workflow (maps logical statuses to project-specific names).
- `removeLabel` — label removed from the ticket after a successful run (idempotency cleanup).
- `removeLabels` — list of labels removed from the ticket after a successful run.
- `scmProvider` — SCM provider override (`github`, `gitlab`, …) for this run.
- `targetRepository` — repository override block (`owner`, `repo`, `baseBranch`, `workingDir`) — run the work against this repository instead of the project default.

/**
 * Unit tests: the pack-release version guard (gh-812).
 *
 * Guards the gh-812 root cause (live 2026-10-09): the release builder
 * derived pack versions from versions.json on main — a ledger whose push
 * back to main is best-effort (a rejected direct push only warns). The
 * ledger never landed, so EIGHT consecutive releases (20261008-095538 →
 * 20261009-091304) all advertised sm_github: 0.1.36 while the content
 * changed underneath; 091304 republished a DIFFERENT sm_github-0.1.36.zip
 * (sha256 20352463… vs 0dc62ca4… from 075526) and version-keyed consumer
 * caches ran mixed content — every fa machine-sm tick red for ~25 min.
 *
 * The guard (ci/pack_version_guard.cjs) encodes the gh-812 contract:
 *   V1 the shipped version beats the ledger — the release history is
 *      append-only and cannot lie; versions.json can (and did).
 *   V2 an affected agent bumps from the SHIPPED base, never re-shipping a
 *      version that is already out there with other content.
 *   V3 a rebuilt-but-unbumped agent whose payload differs from what its
 *      unchanged version already shipped gets an extra patch bump —
 *      two releases with differing pack content NEVER share a version
 *      string (gh-812 AC2).
 *   V4 the payload fingerprint covers file paths + sha256 only — manifest
 *      metadata (version, sourceCommit) changes on every rebuild and must
 *      not force a bump by itself.
 *
 * Uses: loadModule(), suite(), test(), assert
 */

/* global loadModule, assert, test, suite */

function guard() {
    return loadModule('ci/pack_version_guard.cjs');
}
